python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0040.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let look at the chair legs more closely:
# The chair legs touch the floor at specific u columns
# Let look at v > 400
for u in range(140, 280):
    col = img[:, u, :]
    # brown mask
    t = np.where((col[:, 0] > 90) & (col[:, 0] < 180) & (col[:, 1] > 40) & (col[:, 1] < 110) & (col[:, 2] < 60))[0]
    if len(t) > 0 and t.max() > 450:
        print(f"u={u}: max_v={t.max()}")

# Also let check the lowest point of each leg:
# Front leg is around u=180..200
# Right front leg? Let look at the bottom row of legs
print("Leg 1 (front):", np.where(img[450:512, 170:210, 0] > 80))
# Let find all pixels in v > 420
pts = np.argwhere((img[:, :, 0] > 90) & (img[:, :, 0] < 180) & (img[:, :, 1] > 40) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] < 60))
# group by legs:
# leg 1: u in 140..170
# leg 2: u in 170..215
# leg 3: u in 245..275
leg1_pts = pts[(pts[:, 1] >= 140) & (pts[:, 1] <= 165)]
leg2_pts = pts[(pts[:, 1] >= 175) & (pts[:, 1] <= 210)]
leg3_pts = pts[(pts[:, 1] >= 245) & (pts[:, 1] <= 275)]
print("Leg 1 bottom:", leg1_pts[:, 0].max(), "at u=", leg1_pts[leg1_pts[:, 0] == leg1_pts[:, 0].max(), 1].mean())
print("Leg 2 bottom:", leg2_pts[:, 0].max(), "at u=", leg2_pts[leg2_pts[:, 0] == leg2_pts[:, 0].max(), 1].mean())
print("Leg 3 bottom:", leg3_pts[:, 0].max(), "at u=", leg3_pts[leg3_pts[:, 0] == leg3_pts[:, 0].max(), 1].mean())
'
